about: The services MCP servers connect to. A gateway server is told by its endpoint host or command (`hosts`, `commands`) first, then by the Smithery id in its URL (servers.json), then by words of its name (`names`, and the id itself). The first block is kept by hand with what tells each service; the rest came from classifying the registry and has only a name and an area. `scripts/mcp_registry.py check` validates this file with servers.json and registry.json.
